log_transport_protocol.title: Log Transport Protocol
log_transport_protocol.description: The network protocol used to transmit log data from internal services to the monitoring/aggregation service.

tls_enabled.title: TLS Encryption Enabled for Log Transport
tls_enabled.description: Whether TLS encryption is enabled on the log transport channel between the log producer and the monitoring/aggregation endpoint.

mtls_mode.title: Mutual TLS Mode
mtls_mode.description: The mutual TLS authentication mode configured for log transport between internal services and the monitoring/aggregation service. Indicates whether both client and server certificates are required and validated.

client_certificate_validation_enforced.title: Client Certificate Validation Enforced
client_certificate_validation_enforced.description: Whether the monitoring/aggregation service explicitly requires and cryptographically validates client certificates presented by log sources, preventing rogue log sources from connecting.

ca_certificate_pinned_or_validated.title: CA Certificate Pinned or Validated
ca_certificate_pinned_or_validated.description: Whether the log source clients validate the monitoring service's certificate against a trusted CA or pinned certificate, preventing impersonation of the monitoring service.

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version permitted on the log transport channel between internal services and the monitoring service.

enabled_cipher_suites.title: Enabled TLS Cipher Suites
enabled_cipher_suites.description: List of cipher suites explicitly enabled on the log transport channel. Includes any RC4, NULL, EXPORT, or anonymous DH suites if configured.

weak_cipher_explicitly_disabled.title: Weak Ciphers Explicitly Disabled
weak_cipher_explicitly_disabled.description: Whether the log transport configuration explicitly excludes RC4, NULL, EXPORT-grade, and anonymous Diffie-Hellman cipher suites.

per_message_integrity_mechanism.title: Per-Message Integrity Mechanism
per_message_integrity_mechanism.description: The cryptographic mechanism applied to each log record to guarantee integrity in transit — HMAC, digital signature, or none.

log_transport_tls_enabled.title: Log Transport TLS Enabled
log_transport_tls_enabled.description: Whether the log transport channel uses TLS, protecting confidentiality and transport-layer integrity, independent of per-message integrity controls.

log_receiver_integrity_verification_enab.title: Log Receiver Integrity Verification Enabled
log_receiver_integrity_verification_enab.description: Whether the monitoring/log-collection service actively verifies per-message integrity (MAC or signature) on receipt and rejects or alerts on failures.

anti_replay_mechanism_enabled.title: Anti-Replay Mechanism Enabled
anti_replay_mechanism_enabled.description: Whether the log transport or logging agent implements an anti-replay mechanism such as sequence numbers, server-side validated timestamps, or nonce-based tokens to prevent retransmission of captured log stream segments.

server_side_timestamp_validation_window_.title: Server-Side Timestamp Validation Window (Seconds)
server_side_timestamp_validation_window_.description: The maximum age in seconds that the monitoring service will accept for incoming log messages based on their embedded timestamps. A value of 0 indicates no server-side timestamp validation, leaving the stream vulnerable to replay.

log_message_sanitization_enforced.title: Log Message Sanitization Enforced
log_message_sanitization_enforced.description: Whether the log pipeline enforces sanitization of incoming log messages to strip or escape control characters and format-string sequences before ingestion into the monitoring service.

log_schema_validation_enforced.title: Log Schema Validation Enforced
log_schema_validation_enforced.description: Whether a strict schema or framing validation is applied at the monitoring service ingest point to reject malformed or structurally invalid log records.

syslog_transport_protocol.title: Syslog Transport Protocol
syslog_transport_protocol.description: The transport protocol used to forward syslog messages to the monitoring/log aggregation service.

log_network_path_type.title: Log Traffic Network Path Type
log_network_path_type.description: Classification of the network path over which log traffic travels from producer services to the monitoring collector, and degree of isolation of the log transport segment.

network_segmentation_controls_present.title: Network Segmentation Controls Present
network_segmentation_controls_present.description: Whether network segmentation controls (e.g., ACLs, firewall rules, microsegmentation policies) are applied to restrict log traffic to authorized producer-to-collector paths only.

hostname_verification_enabled.title: Hostname Verification Enabled
hostname_verification_enabled.description: Whether the log shipping agent verifies that the TLS certificate hostname matches the expected monitoring endpoint hostname.

tls_verification_mode.title: TLS Verification Mode
tls_verification_mode.description: The TLS verification mode configured on the log shipping agent for outbound connections to the monitoring/log aggregation endpoint.

certificate_authority_pinning_configured.title: Certificate Authority Pinning Configured
certificate_authority_pinning_configured.description: Whether the log shipping agent pins to a specific trusted CA or certificate fingerprint, preventing acceptance of arbitrary self-signed or rogue certificates.

per_source_rate_limiting_enabled.title: Per-Source Rate Limiting Enabled
per_source_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether the log transport path enforces per-source rate limits, preventing any single service from flooding the log channel.

backpressure_mechanism_configured.title: Backpressure Mechanism Configured
backpressure_mechanism_configured.description: Whether the log transport path has a backpressure or flow-control mechanism that signals upstream producers to slow down when the channel or buffer is saturated.

log_channel_overflow_policy.title: Log Channel Overflow Policy
log_channel_overflow_policy.description: The policy applied when the log transport buffer or channel reaches capacity, determining whether logs from other services are silently lost.

switch_port_mirror_audit_enabled.title: Switch Port Mirror/SPAN Audit Enabled
switch_port_mirror_audit_enabled.description: Whether the network infrastructure has controls or monitoring in place to detect unauthorized SPAN/TAP sessions or port mirroring configurations on switches in the log transport path.
